important_evidence: AI4AVP is a CNN-based deep learning predictor for antiviral peptides, with PC6 encoding and WGAN-GP data augmentation.
Model code available at https://github.com/LinTzuTang/AI4AVP_predictor, GAN code at https://github.com/lsbnb/amp_gan.
Web server freely accessible at http://axp.iis.sinica.edu.tw/AI4AVP/.
Training set: 2934 AVPs, negative set from Swiss-Prot non-AMP plus random sequences; GAN augmented set: 16995 positives + 16995 negatives.
External test set: AVP_testing (293 AVPs + 293 non-AVPs).
uncertainties: Model weights not reported in available evidence.
